@Roth.pow_rootMultiplicity_le : ∀ {R : Polynomial ℤ},
  R ≠ 0 →
    ∀ {h : ℤ} {q : ℕ},
      0 < q →
        IsCoprime h ↑q →
          ∀ {B : ℝ},
            |↑R.leadingCoeff| ≤ B →
              ↑q ^ Polynomial.rootMultiplicity (↑h / ↑q) (Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) R) ≤ B

theorem Roth.pow_rootMultiplicity_le : ∀ {R : Polynomial ℤ},
  R ≠ 0 →
    ∀ {h : ℤ} {q : ℕ},
      0 < q →
        IsCoprime h ↑q →
          ∀ {B : ℝ},
            |↑R.leadingCoeff| ≤ B →
              ↑q ^ Polynomial.rootMultiplicity (↑h / ↑q) (Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) R) ≤ B :=
fun {R} hR {h} {q} hq hcop {B} hB ↦
  Exists.casesOn (Roth.exists_eq_pow_mul_of_rootMultiplicity hq hcop) fun Q hQ ↦
    let t := Polynomial.rootMultiplicity (↑h / ↑q) (Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) R);
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg (fun _a ↦ ↑q ^ _a ≤ B)
          (have this := rfl;
          this)))
      (have hlc :=
        Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a.leadingCoeff = ↑q ^ t * Q.leadingCoeff)
              (Eq.mp
                (congrArg (fun _a ↦ R = (Polynomial.C ↑q * Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C h) ^ _a * Q)
                  (have this := rfl;
                  this))
                hQ)))
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a = ↑q ^ t * Q.leadingCoeff)
                (Polynomial.leadingCoeff_mul ((Polynomial.C ↑q * Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C h) ^ t) Q)))
            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a * Q.leadingCoeff = ↑q ^ t * Q.leadingCoeff)
                  (Polynomial.leadingCoeff_pow (Polynomial.C ↑q * Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C h) t)))
              (Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a.leadingCoeff ^ t * Q.leadingCoeff = ↑q ^ t * Q.leadingCoeff)
                    (sub_eq_add_neg (Polynomial.C ↑q * Polynomial.X) (Polynomial.C h))))
                (Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg
                      (fun _a ↦
                        (Polynomial.C ↑q * Polynomial.X + _a).leadingCoeff ^ t * Q.leadingCoeff =
                          ↑q ^ t * Q.leadingCoeff)
                      (Eq.symm Polynomial.C_neg)))
                  (Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a ^ t * Q.leadingCoeff = ↑q ^ t * Q.leadingCoeff)
                        (Polynomial.leadingCoeff_linear
                          (cast
                            (Eq.symm
                              (Eq.trans (congrArg (Ne ↑q) (Eq.symm Nat.cast_zero)) (congrArg Not Nat.cast_inj._simp_1)))
                            (LT.lt.ne' hq)))))
                    (Eq.refl (↑q ^ t * Q.leadingCoeff)))))));
      have h1 :=
        cast
          (Eq.trans
            (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg LE.le (Eq.symm Nat.cast_one)) |Q.leadingCoeff|)
              (congrFun' (congrArg LE.le Nat.cast_one) |Q.leadingCoeff|))
            (Eq.symm
              (Eq.trans
                (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg LE.le (Eq.symm Nat.cast_one)) |↑Q.leadingCoeff|)
                  (Eq.trans
                    (Eq.trans (congrArg (LE.le ↑1) Int.cast_abs._simp_1)
                      (congrArg (fun x ↦ x ≤ ↑|Q.leadingCoeff|)
                        (Eq.trans Nat.cast_one (Eq.symm (Eq.trans (congrArg Int.cast Nat.cast_one) Int.cast_one)))))
                    Int.cast_le._simp_1))
                (congrFun' (congrArg LE.le Nat.cast_one) |Q.leadingCoeff|))))
          (Int.one_le_abs
            (Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr
              (right_ne_zero_of_mul
                (Eq.mp
                    (congrArg (fun _a ↦ R = (Polynomial.C ↑q * Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C h) ^ _a * Q)
                      (have this := rfl;
                      this))
                    hQ ▸
                  hR))));
      LE.le.trans (le_mul_of_one_le_right (le_of_lt (pow_pos (Nat.cast_pos'.mpr hq) t)) h1)
        (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a ^ t * |↑Q.leadingCoeff| ≤ B) (Nat.abs_cast q))
          (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a * |↑Q.leadingCoeff| ≤ B) (abs_pow (↑q) t))
            (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a ≤ B) (abs_mul (↑q ^ t) ↑Q.leadingCoeff))
              (Eq.mp
                (congrFun'
                  (congrArg LE.le
                    (congrArg abs
                      (Eq.trans (Int.cast_mul (↑q ^ t) Q.leadingCoeff)
                        (congrFun'
                          (congrArg HMul.hMul
                            (Eq.trans (Int.cast_pow (↑q) t) (congrFun' (congrArg HPow.hPow (Int.cast_natCast q)) t)))
                          ↑Q.leadingCoeff))))
                  B)
                (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a ↦ |↑_a| ≤ B) hlc) hB))))))
